scripts.verify:backend: tmp_db=$(mktemp /tmp/ai-video-platform-pytest-XXXXXX.db) && trap 'rm -f "$tmp_db"' EXIT && cd backend && DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///$tmp_db E2E_REQUIRE_ISOLATED_DB=true python3 -m pytest
scripts.verify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-verify npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify:security: python3 tools/security/check_tracked_files.py && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high && pip-audit -r backend/requirements.lock
scripts.verify:production-os: npm run verify:frontend && npm --prefix frontend run e2e:production-os
scripts.verify:quick: npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:e2e
